parsed.explanation: The write-up only sketches the universal lower bound. Its matching identity relies on an omitted exchange argument, while the component and slack construction is presented in compressed assertions rather than a complete all-n derivation. It also never explicitly substitutes the normalized geometric lengths and verifies the super-increasing margin δ = 1/(2^(n+1)-1). The numerical checks and statements that the proof “looks complete” or “needs writing” cannot establish L3.3. A fully written lemma proving the matching/component argument and its geometric specialization is required.
